title: Complete Character Skill Animation Overhaul & Per-Fighter Choreography (9 Playable Characters)
author: Antigravity Senior Game Animator & Canvas Rendering Engineer
objective: Eliminate shared template animations across all 9 playable characters by introducing a 5-stage skill choreography engine (Anticipation -> Cast -> Impact -> Follow-Through -> Recovery), per-character weapon/martial-style attack/counter/dodge/finisher/ultimate poses, damped secondary motion, and deterministic character-signature Canvas VFX without altering combat rules, stats, hitboxes, or state IDs.
requestedBehavior: 1. Multi-stage easing & stage-progress evaluation in AnimUtil + damped secondary motion physics across cloth/hair/sleeves/plumes/weapons. 2. Eliminate all Ultimate POSE_ALIAS fallbacks (huavudai, bichlam, dunghai, giangmanh) and upgrade all 9 ultimates + finishers + counters + dodges + combos to match each character's identity & weapons. 3. Replace generic cyan/setTimeout EffectManager bursts with deterministic dt-driven character-signature VFX primitives and pooled bounded particle lifecycle. 4. Build an interactive Skill Animation Showcase (harness/preview_skill_showcase.html) using the live SkeletalRenderer + EffectManager with 5-stage timeline, replay, and slow-mo inspection, and enrich Character Select Demo VFX. 5. Maintain 100% pass rate on all regression suites, interface guards, and browser smoke checks.

authorizedRemovals: setTimeout scheduling inside EffectManager.createUltimateBlast replaced with dt-driven scheduledEffects

acceptanceCriteria: Every playable character has unique 5-stage animations for Ultimates, Finishers, Counters, Dodges, and Combos matching their silhouette and weapon identity
Zero Ultimates rely on POSE_ALIAS fallbacks to normal attacks
Zero setTimeout calls remain inside skill VFX bursts
Particle arrays remain bounded and cleanly clear on state transitions
Skill Animation Showcase renders real SkeletalRenderer + EffectManager frames cleanly with 5-stage timeline
All regression suites and headless Chromium browser smoke checks pass with 0 console errors
